notes.title: Update 1.4 to the IndieAssemble festival and a -75% discount
notes.notes:
[h2]Version 1.4 – What's New[/h2]
In this update, I have improved lighting and made the game more comfortable and accessible.

[list]
[*] I added a color palette setting for people with color blindness
[*] The main menu settings are now more user-friendly
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/4d43546a0739836310cb28cded3ed891644a873b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Camera shake has been added, but it can be disabled in the settings
[*] I added FXAA anti-aliasing. It is enabled on high and epic presets instead of TAA, as it was before
[*] Clouds now appear in the sky. Additionally, I improved the lighting, so there are fewer dark spots in the game
[*] The camera automatically tilts to make it easier to look up or down on stairs and attack enemies
[*] Rooms and caves now have echo effects
[*] The gamepad will vibrate in some scenes and when the player takes significant damage
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3 for the Winter Sale -50%
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/fa4c24131251e9a8a115b7dbb830e607fc4e6f32.png[/img]

[h1]ːsteamhappyːThe game is on discountːsteamhappyː[/h1]
Winter has come, and the holiday season has begun.
And I have prepared some fixes and improvements:

[list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[*]     I fixed a bug where the game would softlock when an enemy with a very fast death animation died from the spiked shield.
[*]     I also improved the background sounds and music: now there is different ambient noise in dungeons, outdoors, and at high altitudes.
[*]     The attack animation of crystal golems has become less jerky.
[*]     The animation of some enemies would get interrupted when they took damage from the spiked shield.
[*]     Fixed a bug where enemies could be facing the wrong direction after shooting.
[h3]Changed View Mode[/h3]
[*]     Previously, when looking around, grid cells would be drawn to show where you could move and which cells were dangerous. Now the cells blink smoothly to avoid spoiling the appearance.
[*]     In JRPG battles, grid cells are no longer needed, so they are no longer shown.
[*]     Also, the Sword and Shield in the hands become completely transparent.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 specifically for the Turn-Based RPG Festival (30.09.2024)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/07a107ad060d7792fbfab24922939bd3613ae1fd.png[/img]
Hello. I have fixed the JRPG mode and made the game a bit more convenient.
[list]
[*] In JRPG mode, allies’ HP is saved between battles, and after a battle, they recover 10 HP.
[*] Allies’ HP is now displayed in the HUD.
[*] Fixed a bug where allies did not take damage from the spikes on skeleton shields.
[*] Added sounds for allies.
[*] Previously, in JRPG battles, backstab would randomly cause an ally to skip a turn.
[*] Now, in JRPG battles, the static shield recharges.
[*] The health bar of a dead enemy used to block the health bar of the enemy that jumps into its place. Now it is removed earlier and does not obstruct.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/8498120f7148289943b0832c64cee01ba3dd582d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Descriptions of sword and shield passives, as well as the effects of different ingots, have been added to the abilities menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where the HUD would disappear.
[*] During buying and selling, if there are still items left, the same window remains active and switches to another if the item is out of stock.
[*] When inlaying, the selected socket rotates and pulses to make it more noticeable.
[*] The unnecessary tab with swords no longer distracts when working with the magic wand.
[*] If an ingot is accidentally selected during socketing, the window does not reset but waits for the player to select a magic stone.
[*] Keys now have different icons. When a key is picked up, it is indicated which key was picked up.
[*] Fixed text errors.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/743927a03381077ccc7d0ffc0580a2f11df22876.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Previously, the grid highlight was ugly, drawn on walls and everything else. Now, in most places, it is drawn only on the floor.
[*] Some players complained about sudden death from falling. I removed these spots but left some so that enemies could shoot at the player, as it affects AI behavior.
[*] Crystals no longer cause panic if shot at.
[*] Fixed a bug where the wand’s backstab ability did not recharge.
[*] Added missing screens to the keymaster’s dialogues when he identifies keys.
[*] Finally, fixed a bug in the finale where enemies would aggro too early.
[*] Added sounds to crystals and changed the sound of mana drops.
[*] Added a visual effect to strong skeletons with halberds to make them immediately distinguishable.
[/list]
 I hope you appreciate these changes and that the game has indeed become better.

notes.title: Great news! Less than a week left until GetToTheGate releases.
notes.notes:
The game will be released on August 19th

Ready to wander the dungeons and streets of the dead city, search for treasures, collect magic stones and champion medallions.

Oh, and the achievements look so cute.

notes.title: Demo update and NextFest stream (prerecorded)
notes.notes:
Hello dungeoncrawler lover! Demo of the GetToTheGate is already available in Steam NextFest! In this demo you will be able to fight two bosses, loot a lot of treasures and solve a lot of puzzles. And in the just released version of the demo, a new route with a new artifact has become available.
[h2]New route New location[/h2]
The Palace is now open. From it you can get to the castle and open treasuries along the way. The most interesting thing is more puzzles and rare keys. Don’t forget to collect as many magic stones as you can, some puzzles can only be solved with the help of skills.
[h2]Artifact[/h2]
The new artifact is a shield that deals damage to enemies who attack you. If you want to ruin the surprise, here's where to find it. It is located in the treasury right next to the palace. To get there you need to buy a key and go through the labyrinth in the garden.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/018147e56a0349046ce751d58d4c40ae44adb40e.png[/img]
[b]Skills[/b]
In the game menu you can see all the skills so that there are no difficulties with choosing yout build.
I also added a free magic stone in the starting city.
Looks like I overestimated the power of the spells, so I'll buff them in the future and I'll make it cheaper to upgrade magic stones.

notes.title: Demo!
notes.notes:
In the first level, Maria needs to reach the castle and defeat the boss.
There are 5 side quests, a lot of dungeons, treasuries, a mini-Boss in the magician’s tower, and Leaderboards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/296d0f8e2d02314a99bdfb1ad3c1e5af8c601b1c.png[/img]
Leaderboards?
Yes, because Maria loses mana and returns to base to regain it. I think it would be cool to compete to see who would spend the least mana on the way to the Boss.
Someone will want to explore the level, farm, and try different builds. Such a player will likely find the boss more prepared.
Other players will want to speedrun the game and Maria's strength will be minimal.
Therefore, each boss has two separate leaderboards:
1) how much mana was spent during the last run;
2) all mana spent for the entire game;

The demo is available for Windows.
Stay tuned.

notes.title: What's New?
notes.notes:
Hi, Maximan is with you. It’s been a warm winter. I am preparing demo-version, so anyone can try the game for free. And I have something to share with you. Ah, I’d like to do everything quickly, but I planned a lot of things and the list of tasks is growing.

[h1]City of Ghosts[/h1]
The first and most notable change is the City of Ghosts. This is the main location. The main character constantly returns here between dungeon runs. The events of the game take place in the World of the dead. Somewhere far away there is Elysium, where the souls enjoy their death. But this is just a town next to the portal. Even though ghosts don’t care about life, they continue to enjoy things, they liked while they were alive. Spirits can help to upgrade weapons and Maria can trade with them.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/a3233a151ce59fef6de0ccfad16f0a39120e482f.png[/img] Almost everything has changed, except for the portal and the booth with the ghost-withard. Previously, there were only two imaginary rooms with merchants, but now it is a neat little town. Also, I changed the terrain.
But not only ghosts live here.

[h1]Pluto champions[/h1]
Well, almost champions. When Maria enters this world, she is not the only one alive person here, These heroes want to pass Pluto’s test to become champions and receive his blessing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/019c68115148f24374e473d1d7fd6f71727a23a5.png[/img]
Most of the candidates are Hellenic heroes – Roman and Greek. The test is to pass through an island with dungeons filled with the undead. And reach the only portal to the world of the living. Poor Maria has to go through the same as the heroes who have been training all their lives. You can meet these guys on the island and in dungeons. They are connected to the main story, but, anyway, Maria will have to do most of the dungeons by herself.

[h1]Advanced waypoints[/h1]
Probably the most important, but unnoticeable change is the waypoint system (the cells along which a player moves). Previously, I had to build levels so that the waypoints didn’t stand one over the other. When I created this system, I thought that I’d get by with the usual ‘two-dimensional’ level. It makes no sense to make a game of tangled maze levels. In any case, I can break one level into two. By the way, therefore, the towers consist of an external staircase and a platform in the center. No floors, no bridges. I also had to make the wall thicker and separate some places with decorative columns and pedestals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308437/64027196bd01fb55bcef448e9772711eff024be0.png[/img]
But now I can place waypoints one on top of the other and they won’t conflict. The most amazing thing is that this change fits very easily and without problems.

Now I can make towers with floors. I promise that I’ll not make too complicated 3D mazes. I hate it when some games do bad vertical levels, so I’ll just try to avoid this bad design.
In general, expect more interesting levels.
